
```{julia}
using CurrentSheetTestParticle
using CurrentSheetTestParticle: Vern9
using CurrentSheetTestParticle: solve_param, ConstField, guiding_center, solve_fl
using CurrentSheetTestParticle.Analysis
using DrWatson
using DataFrames, DataFramesMeta
using CairoMakie, AlgebraOfGraphics
using Beforerr
```

The time it takes for a particle to resonate with consecutive current sheets corresponds to the duration the particle spends within the current sheet $T_{cs}$ plus the time it takes to free stream along the magnetic field line $T_{fs}$: $T=T_{cs} + T_{fs}$

The value of $T_{cs}$ is obtained from test particle simulations. To calculate $T_{fs}$, we divide the distance between adjacent current sheets, denoted as $s$, by the particle’s changed parallel velocity $v_{∥,1}$ after the interaction with the current sheet. The separation distance $s_{fs}$ is treated as a system parameter.

$T_{fs} = \frac{s_{fs}}{|v_{∥,1}|}$

In the absence of scattering by the current sheet, the particle would stream freely over a distance given by the unperturbed parallel velocity $v_{∥,0}$ multiplied by the total time $T$; that is:

$$
s_0 = v_{∥,0} T = v_{∥,0} (T_{cs} + s_{fs}/|v_{∥,1}|)
$$

By comparison, when a particle undergoes interaction with the current sheet, the total distance it covers is $s = s_{cs}^{*} + sign(\frac{v_{∥,1}}{v_{∥,0}})s_{fs}$, where $s_{cs}^{*}$ is the effective parallel distance traveled within the current sheet.

$$
Δs_∥ = s - s_0 = (s_{cs}^{*} - v_{∥,0} T_{cs}) + s_{fs}(1- v_{∥,0}/v_{∥,1}) ≈  s_{fs} (1- v_{∥,0}/v_{∥,1} - v_{∥,0} T_{cs}/s_{fs})
$$

Diffusion coefficient $κ$ is defined as:

$$
\begin{align}
κ_∥ &= \frac{(Δs_∥)^2}{Δt} = \frac{(s_{fs} (1- v_{∥,0}/v_{∥,1} - v_{∥,0} T_{cs}/s_{fs}))^2}{ (T_{cs} + s_{fs}/v_{∥,1})}
\\
κ_⊥ &= \frac{(Δs_⊥)^2}{Δt} = \frac{(Δs_⊥)^2}{ (T_{cs} + s_{fs}/v_{∥,1})}
\end{align}
$$



```{julia}
function run_sim(d; verbose=false)
    save_everystep = false
    diffeq = (; dtmax=1e-3)
    init_kwargs = (; w=-0.8:0.2:0.8, Nϕ=128)
    sols, (wϕs, B, u0s) = solve_params(RDProblemParams(; diffeq, init_kwargs, d...); save_everystep, verbose)
    results = process_sols(sols, B, wϕs)
    results.v .= d[:v]
    results.θ .= d[:θ]
    results.β .= d[:β]
end

function run_upperturbed(df)
    @chain df begin
        @transform! :u1_0 = solve_unperturbed.(:B, :u0, :t1; diffeq)
        @rtransform!(:Δx = :u1[1] - :u0[1], :Δy = :u1[2] - :u0[2], :Δz = :u1[3] - :u0[3])
        @rtransform!(:lx = :u1_0[1] - :u0[1], :ly = :u1_0[2] - :u0[2], :lz = :u1_0[3] - :u0[3])
        @rtransform!(:δx = :Δx - :lx, :δy = :Δy - :ly, :δz = :Δz - :lz)
    end
end

getaxis(ae::AxisEntries) = ae.axis
getaxis(p) = map(getaxis, p)
```

```{julia}
function solve_unperturbed(B, u0, t1; save_everystep=false, alg=Vern9(), kw...)
    Bc = ConstField(B(u0))
    tspan = Float64.((0, t1))
    sol0 = solve_param(Bc, u0, tspan; save_everystep, alg, kw...)
    return sol0.u[end]
end
```

```{julia}
config = Dict(
    :θ => 60,
    :β => [5, 10, 30, 60],
    :v => 8,
)
all_params = dict_list(config)
results = run_sim.(all_params)
result = vcat(results...)
process!(result)
```

```{julia}
using LinearAlgebra
para_dist(p, p0, û) = dot(p - p0, normalize(û))

save_everystep = false
@chain result begin
    @rtransform! @astable begin
        :gc0 = guiding_center(:u0, :B)
        :gcf = guiding_center(:u1, :B)
        :Bz0 = :B(:gc0)[3]
        :s = abs(:v * :μ0 * :t1)
        sgn = sign(:Bz0 * :gc0[3])
        tspan = (0, -sgn * :s)
        fl = solve_fl(:gc0, :B; tspan, save_everystep)
        :u1_fl = fl.u[end]
        :û = :B(:u1_fl)
        :para_dist = para_dist(:gcf, :gc0, :û)
    end
end
```


```{julia}
orig_f(x) = x[3] > 0 ? "up" : "down"
spec0 = data(results[1]) * AlgebraOfGraphics.density()
spec = spec0 * mapping(col=:u0 => orig_f)
legend = (; position=:top)
f = Figure()

p1 = draw!(f[1, 1], spec * mapping([:δx, :Δx, :lx], color=dims(1) => renamer(["δr (Δr - l_r)", "Δr", "l_r"])))
p2 = draw!(f[2, 1], spec * mapping([:δy, :Δy, :ly], color=dims(1)))
p3 = draw!(f[3, 1], spec * mapping([:δz, :Δz, :lz], color=dims(1)))
p4 = draw!(f[1:3, 2], spec0 * mapping(:Δμ, color=:u0 => orig_f))
legend!(f[0, 1], p1; tellwidth=false)
legend!(f[0, 2], p4; tellwidth=false)
f
```

```{julia}
using Statistics
f = Figure()
color = :β => nonnumeric
row = :u0 => orig_f
col = dims(1) => renamer(["", "", ""])
facet = (; linkyaxes=:none)
spec = data(result) * AlgebraOfGraphics.density(; npoints=800)
p1 = draw!(f[1, 1], spec * mapping([:δx, :δy, :δz]; col, color); facet)
p4 = draw!(f[2, 1], spec * mapping([:δx, :δy, :δz]; col, color, row); facet)
xlims!(p1[1].axis, 0, 150)
xlims!(p1[2].axis, -67, 67)
xlims!(p1[3].axis, -67, 67)
xlims!.(getaxis(p4[:, 1]), 0, 150)
xlims!.(getaxis(p4[:, 2]), -67, 67)
xlims!.(getaxis(p4[:, 3]), -67, 67)
legend!(f[0, :], p1; tellwidth=false, orientation=:horizontal)
easy_save("δr_βscan")
```

```{julia}
using CurrentSheetTestParticle: field_lines_distance

dists = map(sols) do sol
    field_lines_distance(sol, B)
end
```

```{julia}
df = DataFrame(dists)
@info "Statistics" maximum(df.dR_perp_min) maximum(df.dR_perp_asym)
@chain df begin
    @transform! :wϕ = wϕs
    @rtransform! begin
        :w0 = :wϕ[1]
        :ϕ0 = :wϕ[2]
    end
end

w0 = :w0 => x -> string(round(x, digits=2))

f = Figure()
spec = data(df) * AlgebraOfGraphics.density() * (mapping(:dR_perp_asym) * mapping(; color=w0))

draw!(f[1, 1:3], spec)
draw!(f[2:4, 1:3], data(df) * mapping(:ϕ0; layout=w0) * (mapping(:dR_perp_asym) + mapping(:dR_perp_min)) * visual(Lines))
f
```
